title: Water Damage Mitigation Emergency Service Call Tariff
content:
Every Water Damage Mitigation tier carries its own emergency service call fee, the after-hours and holiday surcharge percentages applied to that fee, an on-site arrival commitment and a late-arrival waiver setting. The figures below are the tier values in force for each of the six tiers.

| Tier | Service call fee (USD per dispatch) | After-hours surcharge | Holiday surcharge | Arrival commitment (minutes) | Late-arrival waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $189.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 | Yes |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $249.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 | Yes |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $219.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 | Yes |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $279.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 | Yes |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $259.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 90 | Yes |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $329.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 90 | Yes |

## Schedule terms
- **Emergency service call fee**: Emergency service call (dispatch and initial inspection) fee per dispatch, USD.
- **After-hours surcharge**: Surcharge on the service call fee when the dispatch falls in the after-hours window (weekdays 18:00-07:59 and weekends), percent.
- **Holiday surcharge**: Surcharge on the service call fee when the dispatch falls on a company-observed holiday, percent (replaces, never adds to, the after-hours surcharge).
- **Arrival commitment**: On-site arrival commitment measured from the booked call to crew arrival, minutes.
- **Late-arrival waiver**: Whether the service call fee is waived when the crew arrives later than the arrival commitment, boolean.

## Reading the schedule
- The fee grows with the water category and with the loss size: the Large Loss tier of each category carries a higher fee than its Standard Loss tier.
- The surcharge percentages and the late-arrival waiver setting are the same on all six tiers; the arrival commitment is shorter on the two Black Water Mitigation tiers than on the Clean and Gray Water Mitigation tiers.
- A tier value here is read from the tier the job holds; this schedule does not itself decide which tier a job holds.
